recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a future work group decision changes the policy for promoting resource-specific statusReason extensions to inline Request or Event resource elements.
issue_request: FHIR-13907 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 by FHIR-I. It asked to put statusReason on Request and Event so reasons for suspended, cancelled, not-done, aborted, and similar statuses could be represented without relying on Provenance, with statusReason subsuming notDoneReason.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the issue was pre-applied in SVN#12374. That revision is imported as git commit 5064224bd079b7f4ef4023d3ead9111b57bd8bff, which added Request.statusReason and Event.statusReason to the active Request and Event pattern spreadsheets. FHIR-13457's Jira comment confirms the same application path and says notDoneReasonCode was subsumed by GF#13907 into statusReason.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists request and event in [logical], so source/request/request-spreadsheet.xml and source/event/event-spreadsheet.xml are active current-build inputs. The current source defines Request.statusReason and Event.statusReason. A prior combined-branch FHIR-7754 reconciliation commit, 6d2b8879416760db0fb8e1e130018bf0d176309c, already fixed the stale active Event and Communication references that still mentioned notDoneReason or obsolete reasonCode wording after the statusReason transition.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No core source edit was necessary because the requested pattern elements are present and the known stale active-source remnants were already fixed by an existing combined-branch commit.
